task_1.title: Restore automatic Conda environment exclusion during test collection
task_1.description: Pytest 8.3.2 fixes a collection regression introduced in 8.3.1 by restoring automatic detection of Conda environments as virtual-environment roots. This prevents pytest from recursing into dependency-installed test trees inside Conda environments unless collection in virtual environments is explicitly enabled.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that pytest automatically recognizes Conda environments during test discovery so upgrading does not cause tests from installed dependencies inside the environment to be collected by default.

expectation.grounded: During collection, pytest should treat a directory as a virtual-environment root when it contains either the standard `pyvenv.cfg` marker or the Conda metadata marker `conda-meta/history`. Directories identified this way should be excluded from default recursive collection, matching pytest's virtual-environment handling, unless collection in virtual environments is explicitly enabled.
expectation.conceptual: Pytest should once again ignore test files that live inside the active environment when that environment is managed by Conda, so normal project runs only collect the project's intended tests unless the user explicitly asks to include environment contents.

constraints.grounded: The change must preserve existing virtual-environment detection based on `pyvenv.cfg`, add Conda-environment detection without requiring user configuration such as `norecursedirs`, and continue to allow explicit opt-in collection of environment directories through the public collection option for virtual environments.
constraints.conceptual: The fix should restore expected default collection boundaries without breaking existing virtualenv behavior or removing the ability for users to intentionally collect tests from inside environment directories.

behavior: A directory containing `conda-meta/history` is recognized as an environment root for collection purposes.
Pytest no longer descends into Conda environment directories during default recursive test discovery.
Projects running pytest from a repository that sits alongside or inside a Conda environment avoid accidental collection of dependency-provided tests.
Directories marked by the standard virtualenv marker `pyvenv.cfg` continue to behave the same as before.
If the user explicitly enables collection in virtual environments, pytest may collect tests from directories that would otherwise be skipped.
acceptance_criteria: When pytest discovers tests in a project and encounters a subdirectory that contains Conda environment metadata, it should skip recursing into that directory by default.
When a project is executed inside a Conda environment, running pytest with default collection settings should not collect tests shipped by installed dependencies from that environment.
When pytest encounters a traditional virtual environment identified by `pyvenv.cfg`, its default collection behavior should remain unchanged.
When the user explicitly enables collection in virtual environments, pytest should allow collection from Conda or standard virtual-environment directories that would otherwise be skipped.
